column2: The full code is about 3,500 lines (mostly the compressed web panel): download robot_otak.ino. Do not upload a file that already contains your token and API keys anywhere public.
Screen: Beranda (home)

Zond's face, clock, battery, and two big buttons: BICARA (talk) and MENU. The face only shows on the home screen. At night, after 2 minutes unused, the face is replaced by a big clock. Other screens return to home by themselves after 45 seconds without a touch
Screen: MENU

six tiles: Musik (SD songs, radio), Info (robot status), Alat (motion modes, camera), Main (rock-paper-scissors), Pesan (messages), and Setelan (settings). Tiles that are still grey come in the next stage. Buttons act when your finger lifts; the ◀ button at top left goes back
Screen: Musik → Lagu SD
title, time bar, previous / play-pause / next, shuffle, repeat, volume, and the song list. The next song plays by itself when one finishes
Screen: Info → Status robot
battery with its graph, front and rear distance, tilt, temperature. The JARINGAN (network) tab shows a QR code of the web panel address: scan it with your phone to open it
Screen: Alat → Mode gerak
Biasa, Jaga, Ikuti, Jelajah (normal, guard, follow, explore). Follow and explore start after a 5-second countdown. While the robot moves on its own, the screen turns red: touch anywhere to stop
Screen: STOP (top right, on every screen)
motors and sound stop the moment it is pressed, mode returns to normal
Screen: tap the face on the home screen
live camera view (touch to close). If there is a new message, tapping the face opens it
Telegram: /pesan Makan malam sudah siap, or the message field in the web panel

the message shows on the screen (yellow envelope icon in the top bar) and Zond says "Ada pesan dari ..." (message from ...). Open it in MENU → Pesan: read, read aloud, delete. The last 10 messages are kept even when the robot is switched off
Screen: Setelan (settings)
speaking voice, AI brain, camera AI features, brightness, night dimming, rotate screen 180 degrees, touch calibration, WiFi info, restart
Screen buttons often miss: open Setelan → Kalibrasi sentuh. Press in the middle of a button and hold briefly; a resistive screen needs pressure, not a light touch.

Want adjustable screen brightness (and automatic night dimming)? Move the screen's LED wire from the 3.3 V rail to IO38, then set #define LAYAR_LED 38. First check there is a small transistor (three legs, marked Q1) near the LED pin of your module; almost every red 2.8" module has one. Without a transistor, the backlight draws too much current for an S3 pin.
